name: dealer-gbp-audit
description: Audit a car dealership's Google Business Profile (GBP) for local SEO and local pack performance. 10-dimension, 100-point framework covering primary category accuracy, secondary categories, NAP consistency, hours, services, attributes, photos, posts, Q&A, and review signal plus response discipline. Single-rooftop default with multi-rooftop dealer-group consistency overlay (additional 25-point scale). Mode A: guided audit with manager access. Mode B: public-search audit for competitor or prospect teardowns.
